notes.title: Update #2 (story stones)
notes.notes:
Changes:

- added [b]story stones[/b] and [b]text library[/b]: collect all writings of the ancient storyteller!
- loading the game is now smoother
- there are more small fish, even in the caves

If you notice any bugs, please write to me (vaeril.games@gmail.com).

Thanks!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Changes:

- fixed font scaling
- added a new tutorial part (regarding darkness)
- loading is now smoother
- game scales better for wide monitors
- small map changes and fixes
- swords and armour are more durable now
- food and sickness decrease/increase is now slower
- added single health items outside of orchards
- fixed wrong light items' durability
- some sounds are now quieter
- fixed a small bug with adding scrolls to libraries
- environment respawn rules are now slightly different
- fixed sickness items' wrong values
- (probably) fixed double respawn bug
- the "dodge" action is now the "blink" action

Thanks!

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
The Otter Ways has just became available on Steam!

Have fun!

notes.title: Release Date - Changed!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'm happy to say that my (quite) long work on the game is coming to an end, and the game will be released on [b]the 4th of April[/b]! Thank you, all those who wishlisted it. I almost haven't advertised it, so it's very motivating! I'm eager to hear your opinions on the 4th (release date change is due to the technical aspects of publishing on Steam, overlooked before).

Thanks for reading!
